title: NARA JFK Releases (2023)
summary: NARA posted thousands of formerly-redacted records: CIA Office of Legislative Counsel journals, JMWAVE cables, CIA Oswald files, Rockefeller Commission/HSCA-era material and DOD files.
tldr: In April–June 2023 NARA posted 2,672 formerly-redacted documents (from 3,648 reviewed) of the JFK assassination collection, on batches such as 422 docs (Apr 13), 502 (May 11) and 1,103 (Jun 27), to meet a June 30, 2023 disclosure deadline.
ai_summary:
AI review of the NARA '2023 Additional Documents Release' index page, read in full:
- Mandate: a presidential memorandum required disclosure of releasable records by June 30, 2023; NARA jointly reviewed the remaining redactions in 3,648 documents with agencies.
- Result: between April and June 2023, NARA posted 2,672 documents containing newly released information — 422 on April 13, 355 on April 27, 502 on May 11, 290 on June 13, 1,103 on June 27, plus 21 on August 24, 2023.
- The indexed records are largely CIA files: JMWAVE cables, Mexico City station cables (Oct–Nov 1963), CIA Office of Legislative Counsel journals, Oswald-related technical analyses (e.g., 201-289248, 'technical analysis of letter and envelope alleging Oswald under control of Chichoms,' 1/3/1964), HSCA-era memos, and DOD-adjacent material — consistent with the record summary's description.
- Record summary verified accurate against the document (both its stated contents and scale).
